style: 16-bit pixel art game art, crisp hard-edged pixels, limited night palette: plum black, deep plum, violet glow, cream, sunset orange, warm orange and gold window lights, the career accent colour only on screens and small glows. Dusk City at night: a skyline made of lit window dots, a few still stars
suffix: no people, no faces, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no sunburst rays, no perspective floor grid, no scanlines, no grain, no glowing particles

assets.prompt: a sleek cream passenger rail car with a plain body and warm lit windows standing on a test track in the middle of the frame at night, just leaving an old arched railway station on the left, the rails curving away toward the city skyline, a small mint signal light glowing beside the track, a few still stars

an engineering workbench at night with a tall cream stand fan prototype in the middle, its front grille taken off and leaning on the bench, one fan blade with a small crack near its root lying beside it, a caliper, a screwdriver, a small coiled spring and a few screws on the bench, a small laptop showing a mint wireframe of the fan blade on its screen, a warm desk lamp, a window onto the night city

an open orange portfolio folder on a wooden desk at night in the middle of the frame, inside it a sheet with a simple sketch of a gear mechanism and a blank card, beside the folder a small toy car made from a plastic bottle with bottle-cap wheels and a small gear, a window with a small cream university gate on a far hill under the moon

a bedroom desk at night seen from the front, a click pen taken apart into neat pieces lined up in a row on a small tray in the middle: the barrel, the ink refill, a coiled spring and the click button, beside it a sheet of paper with a simple line drawing of the pen parts and arrows, a pencil, a warm desk lamp, the moon in the window, a small orange flag

a rooftop at the edge of the city just before sunrise, a thin orange band of first light on the horizon, a path of glowing tiles that splits in two, one branch leading to a distant rail bridge with a small lit train, the other to a distant factory with a few slow wind turbines, a small mint flag planted where the path splits
a vertical top-down game world map at night: five small dark islands in a deep plum sea, tiny lit windows on each island, no path, no labels
a chunky pixel picture frame, mint outer border, orange corner studs, deep plum dithered interior with a few stars, empty centre
the PassionSeed flame logo as a pixel game host: yellow flame body, black face, big white eyes, holding a small mic, transparent background
the same flame host, mouth open mid-sentence, transparent background
the same flame host winking, transparent background
